question: What role in establishing stability over all waters is attributed to this deity?
premises: The deity causes abiding over all waters.
The deity is stability itself and to be established.
The deity is fond of stability.
inference: This deity is the foundation and lover of cosmic stability.
uncertainties: sarva-uda-adhi-sthiti-karaḥ may refer to abiding over all oceans or all waters
plain_english: He establishes abiding over all waters, is stability itself, is to be established, and is fond of stability.
